import ast, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
# moved archived research modules from git status
out=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-status','--find-renames=50%','--','research/v13','research/v15','research/v16','archive/research/v13','archive/research/v15','archive/research/v16'], text=True)
arch=[]
for line in out.splitlines():
    parts=line.split('\\t')
    if parts and parts[0].startswith('R') and len(parts)>=3 and parts[2].endswith('.py'):
        arch.append(Path(parts[2]))
arch_mod={p.stem:p for p in arch}
print('archived_py',len(arch_mod))
# source paths to inspect, excluding archive/data/out/bak
src=[]
for base in ['research/v13','research/v15','research/v16','scripts','tools','tests/v13','tests/v15','app','services']:
    if Path(base).exists():
        for p in Path(base).rglob('*.py'):
            if any(part in {'out','__pycache__'} for part in p.parts): continue
            src.append(p)
# direct text references by archived module stem
refs=[]
for p in src:
    txt=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    for stem, ap in arch_mod.items():
        if stem in txt:
            refs.append((str(p), stem, str(ap)))
print('direct_refs_to_archived',len(refs))
for r in refs[:200]: print('REF',*r,sep='\\t')
# AST imports from source to archived stems
ast_refs=[]
for p in src:
    try: tree=ast.parse(p.read_text(errors='ignore'), filename=str(p))
    except SyntaxError as e:
        print('SYNTAX',p,e); continue
    for n in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Import):
            for a in n.names:
                top=a.name.split('.')[0]
                if top in arch_mod:
                    ast_refs.append((str(p), n.lineno, top, str(arch_mod[top])))
        elif isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom):
            if n.module:
                top=n.module.split('.')[0]
                if top in arch_mod:
                    ast_refs.append((str(p), n.lineno, top, str(arch_mod[top])))
print('ast_imports_to_archived',len(ast_refs))
for r in ast_refs: print('IMP',*r,sep='\\t')

     1	"""V13 S3 ledger downloader (Alberto direction TG 7441, 2026-05-27).
     2	
     3	Replaces the rate-limited userNonFundingLedgerUpdates + userFunding REST
     4	loop with a one-time bulk download from hl-mainnet-node-data S3 bucket.
     5	
     6	Source: hl-mainnet-node-data/misc_events_by_block/hourly/YYYYMMDD/H.lz4
     7	  - Path: per-day, per-hour LZ4-compressed JSONL of block events
     8	  - Block format: {block_number, block_time, local_time, events: [...]}
     9	  - Event shape: {time, hash, inner: {EventType: {...payload...}}}
    10	
    11	Event types we extract:
    12	  - LedgerUpdate: inner.LedgerUpdate.delta has IDENTICAL shape to
    13	    userNonFundingLedgerUpdates response. Wallets affected listed in
    14	    inner.LedgerUpdate.users[].
    15	  - Funding: inner.Funding.deltas[] has {user, coin, funding_amount, szi,
    16	    funding_rate}. Reshape to match userFunding response.
    17	
    18	Output:
    19	  - /Users/hermes/quants-lab/app/data/v13/raw_ledger_cache_20k/{wallet}_{start_ms}_{end_ms}.json
    20	  - /Users/hermes/quants-lab/app/data/v13/raw_funding_cache_20k/{wallet}_{start_ms}_{end_ms}.json
    21	  - Format matches what v13_equity_reconstruct.get_non_funding_ledger_updates +
    22	    get_funding_updates cache readers expect.
    23	
    24	Stream + discard: NEVER persist the raw lz4 to disk. Download, decompress in
    25	memory, parse, accumulate per-wallet, flush per-day.
    26	
    27	ETA: 175 days × 24 hours = 4,200 files × ~10MB compressed = ~42GB egress.
    28	At 50MB/s = ~14min download. Plus parse time ≈ 1-2h total.
    29	"""

    58	def parse_block_time(s: str) -> int:
    59	    """Parse '2026-05-24T00:00:00.038099382' → ms since epoch."""
    60	    # Truncate nanoseconds to microseconds for fromisoformat
    61	    if '.' in s:
    62	        head, frac = s.split('.', 1)
    63	        frac = (frac + '000000')[:6]
    64	        s = f'{head}.{frac}'
    65	    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(s).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    66	    return int(dt.timestamp() * 1000)
    67	
    68	
    69	def stream_one_hour(s3, day: str, hour: int, wallets_lc: set, start_ms_filter: int, end_ms_filter: int):
    70	    """Download + decompress one hour file in memory, yield (kind, user_lc, entry).
    71	
    72	    kind in {'ledger', 'funding'}.
    73	    """
    74	    key = f'{PREFIX}/{day}/{hour}.lz4'
    75	    try:
    76	        resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=BUCKET, Key=key, RequestPayer='requester')
    77	        raw = resp['Body'].read()
    78	    except ClientError as e:
    79	        logger.warning(f'S3 fetch failed {key}: {e}')
    80	        return
    81	    try:
    82	        data = lz4.frame.decompress(raw)
    83	    except Exception as e:
    84	        logger.warning(f'lz4 decompress failed {key}: {e}')
    85	        return
    86	    n_ledger = 0
    87	    n_funding = 0
    88	    for line in data.split(b'\n'):
    89	        if not line:
    90	            continue
    91	        try:
    92	            block = json.loads(line)
    93	        except Exception:
    94	            continue
    95	        # Block time is the canonical event timestamp
    96	        block_time_str = block.get('block_time')
    97	        if not block_time_str:
    98	            continue
    99	        try:
   100	            block_time_ms = parse_block_time(block_time_str)
   101	        except Exception:
   102	            continue
   103	        # Window filter (cheap-skip non-window blocks)
   104	        if block_time_ms < start_ms_filter or block_time_ms > end_ms_filter:
   105	            continue
   106	        for ev in block.get('events', []):
   107	            inner = ev.get('inner') or {}
   108	            ev_time = ev.get('time')
   109	            ev_hash = ev.get('hash')
   110	            # Prefer event-level time over block-level if present.
   111	            try:
   112	                event_time_ms = parse_block_time(ev_time) if ev_time else block_time_ms
   113	            except Exception:
   114	                event_time_ms = block_time_ms
   115	            for kind_key, payload in inner.items():
   116	                if kind_key == 'LedgerUpdate':
   117	                    delta = payload.get('delta', {})
   118	                    users = payload.get('users', [])
   119	                    # Emit one entry per affected wallet IN OUR SET.
   120	                    for u in users:
   121	                        u_lc = u.lower() if isinstance(u, str) else ''
   122	                        if u_lc in wallets_lc:
   123	                            entry = {
   124	                                'time': event_time_ms,
   125	                                'hash': ev_hash or '',
   126	                                'delta': delta,
   127	                            }
   128	                            yield ('ledger', u_lc, entry)
   129	                            n_ledger += 1
   130	                elif kind_key == 'Funding':
   131	                    # inner.Funding.deltas: per-user funding deltas
   132	                    deltas = payload.get('deltas', [])
   133	                    for d in deltas:
   134	                        u = d.get('user', '')
   135	                        u_lc = u.lower() if isinstance(u, str) else ''
   136	                        if u_lc in wallets_lc:
   137	                            # Reshape to userFunding response format
   138	                            entry = {
   139	                                'time': event_time_ms,
   140	                                'hash': ev_hash or '',
   141	                                'delta': {
   142	                                    'type': 'funding',
   143	                                    'coin': d.get('coin', ''),
   144	                                    'usdc': d.get('funding_amount', '0'),  # signed
   145	                                    'szi': d.get('szi', '0'),
   146	                                    'fundingRate': d.get('funding_rate', '0'),
   147	                                    'nSamples': d.get('n_samples', 1),
   148	                                },
   149	                            }
   150	                            yield ('funding', u_lc, entry)
   151	                            n_funding += 1
   152

   154	def flush_per_wallet(buckets: dict, out_dir: Path, suffix_window: str):
   155	    """Persist per-wallet entries to JSON files. Append-merge if file exists."""
   156	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   157	    n_files = 0
   158	    n_entries = 0
   159	    for wallet_lc, entries in buckets.items():
   160	        path = out_dir / f'{wallet_lc}{suffix_window}.json'
   161	        # Merge with existing (in case of restart with overlapping days)
   162	        existing = []
   163	        if path.exists():
   164	            try:
   165	                with open(path) as f:
   166	                    existing = json.load(f)
   167	            except Exception:
   168	                existing = []
   169	        merged = existing + entries
   170	        # Dedup by (time, hash) — same event from overlapping fetch
   171	        seen = set()
   172	        deduped = []
   173	        for e in merged:
   174	            key = (e.get('time'), e.get('hash'), json.dumps(e.get('delta', {}), sort_keys=True))
   175	            if key in seen:
   176	                continue
   177	            seen.add(key)
   178	            deduped.append(e)
   179	        # Sort by time ascending
   180	        deduped.sort(key=lambda e: e.get('time', 0))
   181	        tmp = path.with_suffix('.json.tmp')
   182	        with open(tmp, 'w') as f:
   183	            json.dump(deduped, f)
   184	        tmp.replace(path)
   185	        n_files += 1
   186	        n_entries += len(entries)
   187	    return n_files, n_entries

   197	    ap.add_argument('--flush-every-day', action='store_true', default=True,
   198	                    help='Flush per-wallet buckets to disk after each completed day')
   199	    ap.add_argument('--days-limit', type=int, default=0, help='Smoke: only process N days. 0=all.')
   200	    ap.add_argument('--ledger-only', action='store_true',
   201	                    help='Skip funding parse/persist. Alberto path A 2026-05-27: funding stays in REST cache; '
   202	                         'avoids ~49GB funding disk on the ledger-only S3 path.')
   203	    ap.add_argument(
   204	        '--manifest-out',
   205	        help='Coverage manifest JSON. Defaults under app/data/v15/manifests/.',
   206	    )
   207	    args = ap.parse_args()
   208

   210	    end_d = datetime.strptime(args.end, '%Y-%m-%d').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
   211	    start_ms_window = int(start_d.timestamp() * 1000)
